title: Absolute rotations reveal relative separation
purpose: Cancel the query rotation and retain the key-minus-query phase difference.
contract: For fixed raw vectors and frequencies: rotated_q(p) dot rotated_k(n) = q dot R(n-p)k.
The ray diagram is illustrative; the independent four-channel fixture supplies the numerical score.
